text:
claire: idea: add a 'confidence ribbon' around per-model cost sparklines to communicate sampling variance + forecast uncertainty. 30m history, 15m forecast.
ishaan: love it. need to decide forecast algo: simple linear extrap vs short AR model. AR might be better for periodic bursts but heavier.
marta: for first cut, linear extrapolation from last N points + multiplicative cache-warmup heuristic is fine. show ribbon as +/- 95% CI when sampled.
claire: sampling: we currently keep 1% traces for token accounting. do we increase or compute CIs from 1%? storage concerns.
ishaan: compute weighted estimates and asymptotic var from sample_weight. no need to increase retention. store per-minute sample_n and sample_sum_weight for robustness.
ryan: API proposal:
```
GET /api/console/v1/models/{model}/cost_pulse?hist=30m&forecast=15m
resp: timestamps[], token_cost[], cache_savings[], ci_low[], ci_high[], forecast_ci_low[], forecast_ci_high[], is_estimated, sample_rate, sample_n
```
claire: please add 'estimation_method' field so UI can show 'linear-extrapolation' or 'sample-extrapolation'.
marta: cache taxonomy: router_prefetch, local_sidecar_kv, shared_cache_edge. normalize tags at ingest or we'll leak noise across tenants.
devops-bot: Job scheduled: telemetry/ingest-add-sample-n-weight-and-cache-tag-normalize @ 2024-09-18T05:00Z
ishaan: backfill plan: don't re-run full aggregator. use sampled-series extrapolation to synth historical points and mark as estimated. cheaper and consistent.
ryan: for attribution across model chains: rule: charge generated tokens to the producer model id; charge input tokens to the route that consumed them. prevents double-counting and aligns with billing expectation.
claire: UX: when a ribbon is wide, tooltip should say 'high uncertainty due to low sample_n' and link to docs. show an 'explain' modal.
marta: also consider a small 'forecast_method' toggle in console dev settings allowing experiments with AR vs linear for alpha tenants.
ishaan: I'll own aggregator changes and CI math. ryan will own endpoint and flagging. marta will open normalization PR for cache tags.
claire: i'll prototype wireframes and short copy for the info modal. will also add e2e tests: synthetic spike, cache-warmup, chain attribution.
ryan: tagging @marta @ishaan @devops-bot for followups. thanks.
